description: A React functional component named NotificationCenter that displays recent notifications received through a real-time hook, showing a notification icon with a count. It subscribes to a real-time notification channel and updates its state when new notifications arrive, maintaining a list of the latest 5 notifications.

methods.name: NotificationCenter()
methods.description: React functional component that renders a notification bell icon with a count of recent notifications. It subscribes to real-time notifications and updates its internal list accordingly.
